about: Which config.json keys spell each of Core's fields, in the order they are tried; crit_core.model.config loads it. text_sections: the sections a multimodal wrapper keeps its text model in. layer_count_from: per-layer lists whose length is the layer count when num_hidden_layers is absent. A mechanism's keys are crit_models' (models/core/python/crit_models/config_keys.json).
